senses.gloss: (b. h.;cmp. Syr. שאן, P. Sm. 4012) to be smooth, be quiet.
(cmp. בטח) to rely on, lean, be supported.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 36">Lev. R. s. 36</cite> <he>מה גפן זו נִשְׁעֶנֶת … נִשְׁעָנִין בזכות התורה וכ׳</he> as the vine is supported by a reed, so Israel relies on the merit of studying the Law which is written with a reed. Y. Bets. V, 63ᵃ top <he>נשענים בבהמה</he> you may lean against an animal (on the Sabbath or Holy Day, it is not considered work for the animal); <he>מאן דאמר אין נשענין בתש</he> he that says, you dare not lean, has reference to a weak animal; a. e.
